caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The chair features a rounded backrest made of a continuous, curved top rail with seven vertical spindles evenly spaced, connecting the top rail to the seat. The seat is a shaped, contoured plank of wood with visible grain and a natural light brown color. The legs are splayed outward and made of turned wood, with two pairs joined by stretchers; the front stretchers are straight, while the side and rear stretchers are curved. The overall color palette consists primarily of varying shades of brown for the chair, rendered with shading to suggest depth and texture, and a light cream color for the background. A thin, rectangular border lines the edge of the drawing, and at the bottom right, text reads “VINCENT PROSEL 390-1 DEL.”
title: Windsor Fan-back Chair
